create_PointTracker: create a PointTracker instance to track SuperPoint corner points across video frames
run_PointTracker_update: run the PointTracker update method with new SuperPoint points and descriptors
get_PointTracker_tracks: get PointTracker tracks filtered by minimum track length
run_nearest_neighbor_match: run nearest-neighbor descriptor matching between two image descriptor sets
run_PointTracker_get_offsets: run PointTracker get_offsets to compute global point ID offsets
